youtube_description:
#chatgpt @StaykumarOfficial #ai #chatbot #shorts #reels #trending #artificialintelligence 
ChatGPT is a chatbot launched by OpenAI in November 2022. It is built on top of OpenAI's GPT-3 family of large language models. ChatGPT is a language model developed by OpenAI. It is based on the GPT (Generative Pretrained Transformer) architecture and has been trained on a massive corpus of text data to generate human-like text. It is designed to generate text based on the input provided to it and can be used for a variety of tasks such as conversational AI, text completion, text generation, and more. The goal of ChatGPT is to provide a high-quality and consistent text response to a given prompt, making it a valuable tool for natural language processing applications.
